explanation: A title showing respect and reverence for God, the almighty Creator.
God's righteousness, which is his ability to judge and act in accordance with what is right and good.
A feeling of happiness and contentment, especially in relation to God's presence and actions.
The planet we live on, and in this context often refers to humanity and all life on earth.
The spiritual realm where God and angels dwell, often associated with a place of perfection and harmony.
Large natural formations on the earth, used symbolically to represent power and stability.
Landmasses surrounded by water, used here as part of a poetic description of the whole earth testifying to God's greatness.
Those who oppose God and his ways, often used to describe evil forces or persons.
Symbolizes God's goodness, truth, and guidance, standing in contrast to darkness which represents evil and ignorance.
Places where people seek protection and safety, but in this context used to show that no one can escape God's judgment.
